imp.desc: Imported parts cost more than making them yourself, but they're always available.
imp.auto_locked: Research Purchasing Manager to automate imports.
store.price_hint: Higher prices earn more per sale but bring fewer customers.
ord.title: Contract orders
ord.desc: Customers pay a premium for bulk orders. Deliver early for a bonus — no penalty if you're late.
ord.none: No orders right now. New ones arrive every couple of minutes.
ord.locked: Orders open after your first sale.
ord.auto: Vans deliver accepted orders automatically, before shop restocking.

set.title: Settings
set.offline_desc: When you return, your city simulates up to {hours} hours of the time you were away, with the same rules as live play.
tut.welcome.title: Your first workshop
tut.welcome.body: This little brick workshop is yours. Tap it, then “Look inside”, to see the hall.
tut.import_wood.title: Order some parts
tut.import_wood.body: Open Imports and order Wooden Pieces. A supplier truck brings them to the receiving bays.
tut.place_bench.title: Place an assembly bench
tut.place_bench.body: Open Build and place an Assembly Bench a few tiles from the receiving bay.
tut.bench_recipe.title: Choose what to make
tut.bench_recipe.body: Tap the bench and choose Block Set as its recipe.
tut.belt_in.title: Connect the bay to the bench
tut.belt_in.body: Choose Conveyor belt and drag from the receiving bay door to the bench. Belts carry items in the arrow direction.
tut.place_packer.title: Pack it for the shop
tut.place_packer.body: Shops sell boxed toys. Place a Packing Station and set it to pack Block Sets.
tut.cartons.title: Cartons for packing
tut.cartons.body: Order Carton Flats in Imports. The packing station takes cartons straight from receiving storage, so no belt is needed. Then belt the bench’s output into the packer.
tut.ship.title: Send boxes to shipping
tut.ship.body: Lay a belt from the packing station into the shipping bay. Your van takes boxes to the Toy Store automatically.
tut.first_sale.title: Wait for a customer
tut.first_sale.body: Watch the van drive to the Toy Store. Residents buy toys at the price you set.
tut.accept_order.title: Take a contract
tut.accept_order.body: Your first sale is done! Open Orders and accept a contract. Bulk orders pay more than shop sales.
tut.research_car.title: Grow your range
tut.research_car.body: Open Research and unlock Toy Cars when you meet the requirements. More products reach more customers.
tut.done.title: You're in business
tut.done.body: Keep an eye on bottlenecks, missed sales and storage. Expand the workshop when you're ready.
note.lost_sales: Customers are leaving the Toy Store: {reason}
note.grant: Cash is low. The community small business fund can help.
grant.title: Community small business fund
grant.body: Running low on cash? The town council offers a one-off grant of {v} to keep local businesses going. Available again after 20 minutes.
sel.house_desc: About {n} residents live in this street. Residents shop at your stores and work in your businesses.
sel.substation_desc: Supplies the neighbourhood grid. Each building has a connection limit (shown in its panel).
sel.for_sale_desc: Larger plots open in the next chapter, together with the Sawmill and Distribution Warehouse.
help.title: How to play
help.loop: Order parts → build a line in the workshop → pack goods → vans deliver → customers buy → reinvest.
help.belts: Belts pointing into a machine feed it; belts pointing away carry its output. Rotate a machine before placing it to choose which side faces where.
help.status: Every machine shows its status light and, when tapped, the exact reason it's waiting and how to fix it.
help.demand: Demand is finite. Lower prices bring more customers; empty shelves and long queues lose sales.
help.controls_touch: Touch: drag to pan, pinch to zoom, twist with two fingers to rotate, tap to select.
help.controls_mouse: Mouse: drag to pan, right-drag to rotate, wheel to zoom. Keys: WASD pan, Q/E rotate, R rotate piece, Esc cancel, Space pause, 1–3 speed.
help.recovery: Mistakes are cheap: early construction refunds fully, and the community fund helps when cash runs out.
